The '''Spitfire rapid-fire laser cannon''' was a type of rapid-fire [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] developed by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The Spitfire had a particularly low power consumption, allowing for a massive number of bolts per second for a sustained period of [[Time/Legends|time]], though it was only effective in short-range engagements.
